summary: Creates, edits, loads, syncs, and procedurally fills DAT tables made of rows and columns of text cells.

key_params.name: edit
key_params.note: Open a text editor to edit table text

key_params.name: file
key_params.note: Load .csv, .tsv, .dat, or tab-treated text from disk or http

key_params.name: syncfile
key_params.note: Live sync DAT contents to and from a disk file

key_params.name: defaultreadencoding
key_params.note: Auto-detect or choose UTF8, UTF16-LE, UTF16-BE, or CP1252

key_params.name: loadonstart
key_params.note: Reload the table from the configured file when the project starts

key_params.name: write
key_params.note: Write table contents to disk when the project is saved

key_params.name: removeblank
key_params.note: Skip blank file rows when loading table files

key_params.name: fill
key_params.note: Manual, set size, set size and contents, fill by column, or fill by row

key_params.name: rows
key_params.note: Generated table row count for fill modes

key_params.name: cols
key_params.note: Generated table column count for fill modes

key_params.name: cellexpr
key_params.note: Expression used to fill generated cells using me.subRow and me.subCol

key_params.name: includenames
key_params.note: Create an extra heading row or column for generated fill names

key_params.name: fills
key_params.note: Repeated fill blocks for Fill by Column and Fill by Row modes

key_params.name: fills0names
key_params.note: Space-separated or expression-driven names for generated rows or columns

key_params.name: fills0expr
key_params.note: Expression used to fill each generated row or column cell

key_params.name: customext
key_params.note: Custom editor extension when extension mode uses a custom extension

common_gotchas: Table DAT is table-form DAT data; use Text DAT for free-form multiline text.
Viewer Active allows manual cell editing, but generated tools should prefer explicit table values or fill parameters.
Other text files such as .py or .glsl are treated as tab-separated table files when loaded through Table DAT.
Sync to File immediately mirrors changes both ways and can create a missing file on first update.
Fill expressions using me.subRow and me.subCol are evaluated per generated subsection cell.
key_concepts: Table DAT stores rows and columns of text cells, distinct from free-form Text DAT content.
Viewer Active supports manual table editing, while Fill parameters procedurally create rows, columns, headings, and cell contents.
File and sync controls let a table load from disk or mirror edits to an external file.
Fill expressions can use row and column context such as me.subRow and me.subCol for generated values.
